posts.name: Manisha
posts.cooked: Last time during my oppe i was not able to clearly see the awk commands that i was writing as a solution that caused lots of trouble for me to see the solutions i was writing. This all was due to fount color. As font color and background color bith were shades of blue so i want to resolve this issue on time

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: That is a client side issue, please ensure your powershell or whatever terminal emulator you are using has sane colors, you can change them anytime, even during the examination, however you should be familiar with how to do it.

posts.name: Manisha
posts.cooked: Thank you for responding. But can you please help me in doing so

posts.cooked:
As these are dependent on your client, there is no single instruction to follow.
